input: independently audited S11 exact-once OOF fields and metrics
scope: scientific eligibility and full-diagnostics routing; no training or tuning

seed_stability.seed_admitted_when: all five outer folds are finite, causal, hard-BC compliant and free of outer-target selection

paired_uncertainty: bootstrap trajectories as paired units within each seed; never bootstrap snapshots as independent
full_diagnostics_rule: All independently admitted S11 finalists proceed to S12 metrics and figures, even when preliminary acceptance eligibility fails, because S12 is diagnostic and performs no tuning.
preliminary_acceptance_eligibility: seed stability AND noninferiority AND (predictive material gain OR physical material gain); spectral, modal, graph or computational gains may only be added by S12 evidence without changing prediction gates
